# do_ViolinPlot() | Distribution comparison

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
#| echo: false
source("../_common.R")
```

Violin plots show the distribution of gene expression or other continuous variables across different groups.

## Basic usage

```{r}
#| eval: false
p <- SCpubr::do_ViolinPlot(sample = sample,
                           features = "CD3D")
p
```

## Multiple features

```{r}
#| eval: false
p <- SCpubr::do_ViolinPlot(sample = sample,
                           features = c("CD3D", "CD8A", "CD4"))
p
```

## Split by variable

```{r}
#| eval: false
p <- SCpubr::do_ViolinPlot(sample = sample,
                           features = "CD3D",
                           split.by = "condition")
p
```
